rec.name: Typeform Quiz Button (PDP, Metafield-Driven)

what.text: A configurable button placed above the variant selector on the product page. Clicking it opens a Typeform survey/quiz (here a 'card calculator' that tells the shopper how many cards they need). The screenshot shows a rounded pill button with a speech-bubble question-mark icon and the label 'Wie viele Karten brauche ich?' (How many cards do I need?). The button is hidden by default and only appears on products with a Typeform form ID set in a product metafield.

why.text: Helps shoppers who are unsure about quantity or fit to get a tailored recommendation right where they choose a variant. This reduces choice uncertainty and the risk of buying the wrong amount, and can raise AOV by recommending larger bundles. The interactive quiz also adds engagement and a sense of personalised guidance. Note: this is inferred; the ticket does not state a rationale.

how.text: Build it as a theme block (named 'CRO | TypeForm Button') in the product page template, positioned above the Variant picker. The block loads the Typeform embed script (//embed.typeform.com/next/embed.js) and renders a data-tf-live widget, using the form ID from a product metafield (standard.typeform_form_id) rather than a hardcoded ID. Show the block only when the metafield has a value. To set it up, enter the Typeform form ID (just the ID, e.g. 01K4…, not the full embed snippet) in the product's metafield. The block must be added to the product template in the specific theme in use. It was built for the 'Focal [Live]' theme, and the button did not appear in a different theme where the block was missing.

items: Button text (e.g. 'Wie viele Karten brauche ich?')
Position in the product template (drag the block above the variant picker)
Per-product Typeform form ID via metafield standard.typeform_form_id

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'standard.typeform_form_id' (Typeform form ID, per product). A Typeform account with a published form. The embed script is loaded from embed.typeform.com. The block is in the Focal theme and must be added to the theme's product template. Other themes would need a port.

items: PDP add-to-cart rate for sessions with a quiz interaction vs. without
Conversion rate and AOV (quiz users vs. non-users)

images.caption: Final button UI: purple-grey pill with a question-bubble icon and the text 'Wie viele Karten brauche ich?'
